Robinhood Chain Collected $4.5M in Daily Fees, Paid Ethereum Just $400 An analysis published by South Korean outlet Digital Asset highlights the gap between Robinhood Chain’s growth and the economic value captured by Ethereum. According to Bitquery, Robinhood Chain collected approximately $4.5 million in transaction fees on September 3 while paying Ethereum just $398 in data posting and proof costs. The analysis argues that growing Layer 2 activity does not necessarily translate into proportional revenue for Ethereum, as much of the fee revenue remains within the L2 ecosystem. — link

WSJ: Polymarket CEO Reportedly Told Staff to Keep Growing and Pay a Fine if Regulators Found Out Amid $10M Stolen-Card Fraud Attempt The Wall Street Journal reported that fraudsters linked stolen debit cards to Polymarket US accounts in February, attempting to move at least $10 million through wagers and withdrawals. At one point, its payment processor rejected more than 80% of the deposits it handled as fraudulent, far exceeding the industry norm of roughly 1%. According to people familiar with the events, CEO Shayne Coplan's response to employees' concerns was to keep growing and pay a fine if regulators ever found out. Polymarket said it has procedures to detect and respond to suspicious activity and is committed to working with regulators and law enforcement. — link

Highlight Clip: Bybit CEO : Bitcoin Is Still Some Way From Becoming Mature “Digital Gold” Bybit CEO : Bitcoin Is Still Some Way From Becoming Mature “Digital Gold” On April 15, 2026, Bybit CEO Ben Zhou said in a Cointelegraph interview at Paris Blockchain Week that Bitcoin is still some way from becoming mature “digital gold.” He said its recent volatility remains too high for traditional financial institutions to treat it as a reliable store of value. Meanwhile, Zhou said stablecoins are better suited for everyday payments, without changing Bitcoin’s long-term role as digital gold. — link

Binance Enters the Pre-IPO Subscription Market Binance Wallet announced the launch of Pre-Access campaigns hosted by PancakeSwap, allowing users to gain indirect tokenized exposure to companies that may go public. Participation quotas can be increased through Alpha Points, onchain bStocks trading volume and holdings, while assets remain self-custodied in users’ wallets. The first project has not yet been announced. — link
